msg: Hi! We're 4 friends from Toronto, all Open Water certified, in Cartagena next week. We'd like to do two dives on Saturday. How much would it be?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Two fun dives in the Rosario Islands are a great way to enjoy the reef, and your Open Water certifications meet the requirement. I’m leaving the price per person below in both currencies; the online price includes the website discount. Would you like to book for Saturday? You can select the date and number of people in the booking calendar: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD (1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)

Has it been *more than 2 years* since any diver in the group last dived?

msg: No, we all dived last year. Saturday works, is there any discount for 4 of us?
reply:
The group discount starts at 5 people, so it doesn’t apply to your group of 4. You’ll still get the 10% online discount automatically when booking directly on our website. The two discounts can stack for groups of 5 or more, but the group discount must be requested before paying.

One last thing so I can give you the right price and link: are you Colombian nationals, or do you have a Colombian *cédula de extranjería* (Colombia's ID card for foreigners)?
